description: This file declares functions and includes dependencies related to disk image creation and configuration in the Cuttlefish project, specifically for assembling disk images and handling disk flags.

methods.name: ResolveInstanceFiles
methods.description: Resolves and prepares instance files needed for disk image creation.

methods.name: CreateDynamicDiskFiles
methods.description: Creates dynamic disk files based on fetcher and configuration data.

methods.name: DiskImageFlagsVectorization
methods.description: Processes disk image flags for vectorization based on configuration.

methods.name: GetOsCompositeDiskConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the configuration for the OS composite disk based on an instance.

methods.name: OsCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Builds a disk for the OS composite disk based on configuration and instance data.

methods.name: ApCompositeDiskBuilder
methods.description: Builds a disk for the application (AP) composite disk based on configuration and instance data.
